demandEvidence.chore: Prepare customer-facing status updates when store operations data is incomplete or changes frequently.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’d be interested to hear how others handle customer-facing status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently.

ease.reason: A student can test drafts from synthetic status rows, but the discussion supplies no implementation support for data intake or messaging.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: online shops may pay for clearer status updates; this discussion establishes no buyer intent or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can draft from fictional changing status rows; live data access, useful fields and accuracy remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A proposed input-to-draft loop is narrow, but staff must verify facts and approve messages; no implementation capability is documented.

evidence.reason: The post directly raises customer-facing updates with incomplete or changing data, but gives no frequency, detailed rules or corroboration.
